description: tools.vocabulary in the same drifted world: the words a catalog screen renders, sent by the code that declares them (TC3). `capabilities` is the CLOSED capability vocabulary with the daemon's own one-line meaning beside each name — the meaning exists because a pill that shows only `spawn_process` asks the person to guess what they are allowing, and it is the daemon's sentence rather than the screen's because two definitions of a vocabulary is the failure this slice was commissioned to end. `families` and `sources` are read out of the entries this world can actually render, which is why `acme` (one enabled server, whose tools are listed under that family) is here and `off` (disabled) is not: an option a filter can never match is a lie in a select. `rerunClasses` is the closed three as `internal/tools` declares them, the same spellings the committed `rerun_classes.json` pins for the rows. Note what did NOT move because two rows drifted: the vocabulary is a fact about the words, and a drift report is a fact about the rows — the two doors answer independently and neither flatters the other.

capabilities.name: asks_human
capabilities.meaning: Suspends the step until a person answers.

capabilities.name: messages_agent
capabilities.meaning: Files a durable inter-agent message and may suspend the step awaiting the answer.

capabilities.name: network_egress
capabilities.meaning: Bytes leave the process toward the network.

capabilities.name: spawn_process
capabilities.meaning: Starts a process, and only behind a policy-issued allow token.

capabilities.name: workspace_read
capabilities.meaning: Reads bytes under the step's workspace root through the one resolver.

capabilities.name: workspace_write
capabilities.meaning: Writes bytes under the step's workspace root.
